title: Find exports that nothing uses
prompt: Do not modify any existing file. The entry point of this project is src/main.js. Find every exported function under src/ that is never imported or called by any other file in the project (exports used only inside their own file, or not at all, count as unused; src/main.js's own exports are the public API and count as used). Write the result to a new file ANSWER.json as `{ "unused": ["<file>#<name>", ...] }`, where <file> is relative to the repository root, sorted alphabetically.
